name: sparx — Playful Mission
tagline: A bright, warm template for playful, mission-driven brands with a give-back at their heart.
description: A playful, colourful, mission-driven DTC storefront for a give-back brand — a warm-cream page broken up by saturated colour bands (a marigold buy-one-give-one band, a navy impact stat, a sage "the rest" band) over a rhythm of shoppable carousels, in a bright `romp` theme. Modelled on the playful give-back DTC archetype; shipped as Rally, a pet-supplies brand that gives one item to a shelter for every one sold.
